{{Top|leg}}
'''"Big Corellian"''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] stereotype. The hallmarks of a "Big Corellian" were wearing loud clothes and a big hat, giving the impression that the individual is a big man, and drives a "[[Big 'Lift]]." [[Vo Lantes]] portrayed himself as the typical "Big Corellian."
